name: UpdateContact
label: Update Salesforce Contact
description: Updates an existing Contact record in Salesforce.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact to update (required).

fields.name: FieldUpdates
fields.label: Field Updates
fields.description: A dictionary of fields to update on the Contact (e.g., Email, Phone, Title).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after updating the Contact.
